clusters.title: For Israelis, U.S. Midterms Show How Far Their Star Has Fallen in America
clusters.summary: Israel once had bipartisan support in the United States, but a strong showing for Democrats, some of whom are deeply critical of the war in Gaza, has left the country with fewer friends in Congress.

articles.title: For Israelis, U.S. Midterms Show How Far Their Star Has Fallen in America
